articles.title: AMD shares slide 8% as report says China links could invite US scrutiny
articles.desc: Shares of AMD plunged by 8% after a report surfaced linking the company to certain Chinese firms, including those on the US government's blacklist. The report indicates that AMD's firmware is being used by a Chinese server manufacturer, which poses potential regulatory issues. Furthermore, the presence of licensing revenue from two restricted Chinese entities adds another layer of difficulty for AMD as it strives to maintain competitiveness against Nvidia.

articles.title: Customs should review classification of bulk Scotch whisky imports: GTRI
articles.desc: Customs authorities are facing a tariff dispute regarding bulk Scotch whisky imports following the India-UK trade agreement. The classification issue revolves around whether Scotch falls under specific tariff codes for spirits or food preparations. Importers currently classify bulk Scotch under a code that entitles them to reduced duties. Recent changes have led to customs reclassifying these imports, which doubles the duty rate significantly.

articles.title: Israeli military completes ground operation in Gaza beyond Yellow Line
articles.desc: Hamas condemned the incursion, which the Israeli military said was to dismantle a "terror tunnel", as a "flagrant" ceasefire violation.

articles.title: Dutch watchdog tells people not to buy AI smart glasses
articles.desc: Tests of glasses showed some misread medicine instructions or pretended to have called an ambulance

articles.title: Piyush Goyal calls for trusted India-US supply chains, deeper economic cooperation
articles.desc: Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal urged India and the US to build trusted supply chains for better collaboration. He highlighted that India's strengths in talent and manufacturing complement America's capital and technology. The minister also encouraged increased partnerships between educational institutions in both nations. Goyal expressed optimism for achieving USD one trillion in exports during the current fiscal year.

articles.title: Amundi CIO says not bearish on France bonds, AI at the start of repricing
articles.desc: Amundi has chosen a reserved approach towards French government bonds, amidst climbing yields and worries regarding fiscal management. Chief Investment Officer Vincent Mortier expressed a preference for bonds from nations with lower debt-to-GDP ratios and shorter maturities. He also highlighted a potential future interest in Japanese government bonds, as local investors may re-enter the market.

articles.title: Sebi roadmap focuses on faster IPOs, easier foreign investor access: Official
articles.desc: Sebi is focusing on streamlining IPO and rights issue timelines to improve market efficiency. The regulator aims to reduce friction across the capital-raising lifecycle for economic expansion. Additionally, Sebi is working on enhancing corporate bond markets and expanding financing sources. It is also reforming municipal bond issuances to encourage urban infrastructure financing. With these changes, Sebi anticipates significantly mobilizing both domestic and global savings for inclusive wealth creation.

articles.title: Anthropic raises $81bn in record-breaking stock market debut
articles.desc: The company behind the Claude chatbot will become one of the most valuable firms in the world.

articles.title: Six listed REIT firms distribute Rs 3,234 cr in Q2 to over 5.25 lakh unitholders
articles.desc: India's six listed Real Estate Investment Trusts distributed Rs 3,234 crore to over 5.25 lakh unitholders. Since their inception, these REITs have distributed over Rs 38,000 crore collectively to investors. The total gross Assets Under Management for the sector exceeded Rs 3.30 lakh crore recently. The strong demand for office space contributed to healthy occupancy and rental collections.

articles.title: Keystone Realtors to launch Rs 5,000 cr worth housing properties in MMR by Mar: CMD
articles.desc: Keystone Realtors is set to unveil residential developments valued at Rs 5,000 crore across the Mumbai Metropolitan Region by next March. With sales bookings hitting Rs 2,000 crore in the first half of the fiscal year, the company is optimistic about achieving targets, particularly with anticipated festive demand boosting sales. Their robust project pipeline includes plans worth Rs 8,000 crore, having already developed over 30 million square feet.

articles.title: Signature Global acquires 10-acre land parcels in Gurugram to build realty projects
articles.desc: Signature Global has successfully acquired two land parcels in Sohna, Gurugram, covering around 10 acres as part of its initiative to bolster its project portfolio. This strategic move complements the company’s focus on expanding its footprint in lucrative regions. Recently, Signature Global also secured a substantial land bid in Raigad, Maharashtra, signaling its ambitions beyond the Delhi-NCR area.

articles.title: Walmart raises its outlook for the year for the 3rd time after a solid quarter
articles.desc: Walmart reported robust third-quarter sales figures, reflecting ongoing consumer demand for affordable shopping solutions. The retailer saw a significant surge in e-commerce sales, rising by 23%. With an emphasis on digital services and advertising, Walmart has effectively preserved its competitive advantage amid growing inflation concerns. Nonetheless, analysts express a cautious perspective regarding future sales forecasts, projecting a total sales growth of 4.9% to 5.2% for the fiscal year.

articles.title: Palo Alto's raised sales forecast powers rally in cybersecurity stocks
articles.desc: Palo Alto Networks recently announced its acquisition of AI startup Applied Compute for $4.5 billion. The company raised its annual forecast, which positively influenced various cybersecurity stocks. Investors are increasingly focused on cybersecurity due to the rise of AI-enabled cyberattacks and recent technology outages. Shares of other cybersecurity firms have surged in response to Palo Alto's optimistic outlook. The Nasdaq composite also enjoyed gains ahead of Anthropic's market debut.

articles.title: India needs $430 billion in exports in five months to meet FY27 target: Piyush Goyal
articles.desc: India requires approximately USD 430 billion in exports from November to March to meet its ambitious target. By the end of October, the country had achieved 57 percent of its export goal for 2026-27. October exports reached an all-time high of nearly USD 90 billion, which reflects substantial growth. Union Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal proposed a target of USD 1 trillion for this fiscal year.

articles.title: More support for households reliant on heating oil
articles.desc: North Northamptonshire Council is encouraging eligible residents to apply for more support.

articles.title: Nasdaq rallies as record Anthropic IPO revives AI stocks
articles.desc: The Nasdaq surged following Anthropic's IPO, which sparked a revival in artificial intelligence investments. Pricing higher than expected, the IPO raked in impressive funds and valuations, positively impacting tech peers like Amazon and Alphabet. Despite some investor caution, notable gains were seen in firms like Palo Alto Networks. Overall, the market displayed a varied performance, reflecting ongoing uncertainties over the Federal Reserve's future rate strategies.

articles.title: Fund managers turn overweight on India, first such classification since Jan
articles.desc: Fund managers have recently indicated an increased interest in investing in India after several months of cautious sentiment. A significant number of investors are concerned about the absence of artificial intelligence-related investment options available. Increased interest in healthcare and shifts toward defensive sectors have been noted, reflecting changing priorities among investors. Despite concerns over potential risks, half of the fund managers predict a soft landing for the global economy.

articles.desc: Arunish Chawla emphasized the need for improved domestic savings deployment and a diversified financial system. He highlighted the importance of supporting micro, small and medium enterprises through effective policy frameworks. Economic Advisory Council Chairman S Mahendra Dev stated that achieving sustained economic growth requires efficient investment strategies. R Mukundan stressed the necessity of reforming financial access for smaller enterprises alongside larger businesses.

India bonds end choppy session little changed as fresh cues on interest rates eyed
articles.desc: Indian government bonds exhibited volatility and ended little changed as market participants awaited interest rate cues. The benchmark bond yield dropped from the previous day's closing level, reflecting market uncertainties. Expectations of rate hikes from the Reserve Bank of India and the Federal Reserve contributed to investor caution. The steadying of US Treasury yields suggests increased investor absorption of tighter financial conditions.

articles.desc: Young entrepreneur earns recognition, standing out among startups, MSMEs and established enterprises for AI innovations advancing mental healthcare, digital twins and environmental conservation.

articles.title: Piyush Goyal, Italy's Tajani seek stronger ties in autos, pharma and technology
articles.desc: India and Italy are fostering stronger economic ties through joint ventures and technology partnerships. They seek collaboration in sectors such as automotive, aerospace, and agriculture. The discussions took place during the recent India-Italy Joint Commission for Economic Cooperation meeting in Rome. Participants highlighted the importance of investment partnerships and technology sharing for successful outcomes. Both countries aim to integrate into global value chains effectively.

articles.title: Stock rally keeps rupee upbeat, traders eye exporters for fresh fuel
articles.desc: The Indian rupee has surged to its highest value in seven months, driven by a notable uptick in equity markets. A 1% rise in the Nifty 50 index has fostered optimism among traders and analysts alike. As the foreign exchange market's corporate activities demonstrate mixed reactions from exporters and importers, improved participation from exporters may further enhance the rupee's strength.

articles.title: India-US FTA could strengthen aerospace partnerships, boost business opportunities: Gautam Singhania
articles.desc: Gautam Singhania emphasized the potential benefits of the proposed India-US Free Trade Agreement for aerospace partnerships. He noted that his company, Raymond Aerospace, has long-standing relationships with American firms. The 23rd Indo-US Economic Summit facilitated networking opportunities to strengthen commercial ties between both nations. Various industry representatives explored collaboration possibilities that could benefit both sides. Increased cooperation in aerospace could lead to growth in business opportunities through this trade agreement.

articles.title: Intuit deepens its investment in India with the opening of its new Bengaluru campus
articles.desc: The new two-tower Bengaluru campus is now home to Intuit’s second-largest engineering center, reflecting its continued investment in India as a top innovation hub. It brings together teams across core product, platform, and AI capabilities that serve tens of millions of customers worldwide.

articles.title: Tiger-backed Razorpay set to file for India IPO as early as next week
articles.desc: Tiger Global-backed Razorpay is preparing to file its IPO papers in India as early as next week, with investor roadshows expected to follow immediately. The Bengaluru-based fintech firm could launch its public offering as early as February, aiming to raise up to $600 million through a mix of fresh and secondary share sales.

articles.title: FCNR-related costs and benefits yet to fully play out for banks: Report
articles.desc: Foreign Currency Non-Resident deposits are expected to significantly influence the performance of Indian banks. The benefits and costs associated with these deposits have not fully materialized for financial institutions. Banks exhibiting a strong position in fixed-rate FCNR deposits may manage rising funding costs more effectively. Variations in loan growth and deposit composition among banks could lead to different performance outcomes.

articles.title: Goldman Sachs names 22 ‘high-growth’ stocks; Bharti Airtel, Eternal and HDFC Bank feature in the list
articles.desc: Goldman Sachs has identified 22 Indian companies exposed to structural growth themes and initiated Buy ratings on 21. Bharti Airtel, Eternal, HDFC Bank and InterGlobe Aviation feature prominently.

articles.title: Meta looks to hire new India policy chief to repair frayed ties
articles.desc: The social media giant is seeking a vice president of public policy, people familiar with the matter said, asking not to be named as the job hasn’t been advertised publicly. Meta representatives didn’t respond to a request for comment.

articles.title: Why AMD shares are rising: 7 things investors should know
articles.desc: AMD shares gained 5.3% after OpenAI revealed AI-driven improvements of up to 14% in its GPU design. A GTA VI connection adds to optimism around its gaming business.

articles.title: Lenovo posts 48% revenue jump on AI-related sales, beating estimates
articles.desc: Revenue rose to $30.2 billion, above an LSEG consenus estimate of $27.6 billion drawn from six analysts. Under Hong Kong accounting standards (HKFRS), the company posted a net loss of $640 million, compared with a net profit of $340 million a year earlier.

articles.desc: Palo Alto Networks shares surged in after-hours trading after the cybersecurity firm reported better-than-expected fiscal Q1 2027 results, with revenue rising 39% year-on-year. The company also announced a $4.5 billion acquisition of AI startup Applied Compute and raised its full-year revenue guidance.

articles.title: Jaishankar meets senior Japanese leaders; discusses deeper strategic, economic ties
articles.desc: S Jaishankar met with key Japanese leaders in Tokyo to discuss strengthening bilateral cooperation. The focus was on enhancing strategic, economic, and energy security ties between India and Japan. In addition, Jaishankar will co-chair the upcoming India-Japan 2+2 Foreign and Defence Ministers' Dialogue. This dialogue aims to review various aspects of defense cooperation and relations. Both nations maintain a Special Strategic and Global Partnership encompassing multiple areas of collaboration.

articles.title: India bonds hold on to opening gains; moves in crude, Treasuries to stay main trigger
articles.desc: Indian government bonds have seen an uptick, supported by international buying activity, boosting bond prices positively. Early trading sessions showed minor fluctuations in the benchmark 6.94% 2036 bond yield. Meanwhile, US Treasury yields stabilized after recent volatility. Crude oil prices held firm, shaped by global supply and demand trends. Anticipation grows in Indian markets for a possible rate hike from the Reserve Bank of India in December.

articles.title: Elon Musk says he feels 'pretty foolish' for failed US election spending
articles.desc: World's richest man Elon Musk said Wednesday he felt "pretty foolish" for donating nearly half a billion dollars to failed campaigns in recent US midterm elections, backing right-wing Republicans in races that were largely won by Democrats. Among the candidates he backed most strongly was Texas Senate candidate Ken Paxton, with Musk contributing an estimated $220 million to the Republican, only for the race to be won by James Talarico, a 37-year-old Democrat.

articles.title: UAE Court orders freeze on crypto tokens stolen from Binance wallets
articles.desc: The court said the 18 named companies were not accused of wrongdoing. Many companies have already frozen tokens that were stolen from Binance on October 29 in the largest crypto heist on record. US authorities have attributed the attack to North Korea.

articles.title: Bill Ackman says Nvidia board rushed Jensen Huang's exit without proper scrutiny
articles.desc: In a post on X, Ackman said the board appeared to have acted under pressure from media reports rather than following a careful decision-making process. He questioned why directors had ruled out Huang's return before all the facts were known.

articles.title: Morgan Stanley is ‘overweight’ on these 9 largecap stocks. How many do you own?
articles.desc: Morgan Stanley has given an overweight rating to nine major largecap stocks in India in light of current market dynamics. While several stocks faced downturns over the past year, some others experienced increases. The analysis stresses that for India to excel on a global scale, earnings growth is vital. Companies like Hyundai Motor and Trent saw significant declines, while Adani Power distinguished itself with impressive growth, underscoring varied market outcomes.

articles.desc: Musk speaking on the New York Times 'Deal book summit' equated Huang being forced out of Nvidia to the Chicago Bulls dropping basketball great Michael Jordan in the middle of a winning streak. "You got to think long and hard before you take someone, let's say you're Chicago Bulls, middle of your second season, and you got a winning streak that's just going to happen, and then you kick Michael Jordan off your team. Doesn't seem like a smart decision to me," he said.

Surge in software patches likely behind recent tech outages, experts say
articles.desc: Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton told a House of Representatives Homeland Security Committee hearing on worldwide threats Wednesday that there is so far no indication that the tech outages are related. But Clayton said the speed and level of capability of computer systems are "increasing substantially," so legacy computer systems and equipment that already were old are aging much more quickly.

articles.title: Arizona says it is investigating OpenAI, other firms over possible rogue agents
articles.desc: The state of Arizona has opened a criminal investigation into OpenAI and other AI companies relating to the "apparent infiltration of banks by rogue AI agents," Arizona Attorney General Kris Mayes said Wednesday. A criminal investigation does not necessarily mean charges will be brought. Mayes said her office was investigating whether Arizona state law was being violated on an ongoing basis.

articles.title: Anthropic prices its IPO at $83 per share, valuing the AI giant at $1.5 trillion
articles.desc: Anthropic decided to barrel ahead with the IPO despite jitters among some investors over market volatility, a potential regulatory crackdown by a Democratic-led Congress next year and growing anti-AI sentiment among the public. Then there's the spectacular downfall of one of the industry's biggest cheerleaders, former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, over extramarital affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese spy.
